notebooklm.comment: Gives Gemini/Claude direct access to NotebookLM notebooks via MCP tools. Used to query Claude Code docs, project docs, etc. Install: uv tool install notebooklm-mcp-cli

gitnexus.comment: Codebase knowledge graph. Gives Gemini + Claude deep architectural awareness: blast radius analysis, call chain tracing, symbol context, impact detection. Install: npm install -g gitnexus. First run: gitnexus analyze (in project root).

stitch.comment: Google Stitch UI — AI-powered UI design tool (Gemini 2.5 Pro). Generates pixel-perfect screens and production-ready HTML/Tailwind from text prompts. Used by Gemini during Phase 0.5 (design) of new projects with significant UI. NOT needed for API-only or CLI projects. SETUP REQUIRED (one-time): (1) Install gcloud CLI, (2) run 'gcloud auth login' + 'gcloud auth application-default login', (3) run 'npx @_davideast/stitch-mcp init' — the wizard handles everything else. Platform: https://stitch.withgoogle.com

railway.comment: Railway MCP — manage Railway projects, services, deployments, logs, and environment variables directly from Claude/Gemini without touching the CLI. Fallback: use railway CLI (already in permissions). SETUP: get token from railway.app → Account Settings → Tokens. Add RAILWAY_API_TOKEN to .env
